campaign_window_utc.note: one window; this is not a multi-day reliability campaign (P2)

manifest.frozen_by: independent reviewer (monchobotjr subagent; not an author of the harness or the tools under test)

host.measurement_host_note: one host; per-run load is recorded so a reader can see whether the runs shared the machine with other work

agent_reach.install_source: GitHub archive at a pinned commit (direct_url)

dependencies.note: both environments were already installed; on-disk size and distribution count are measured, install duration is not re-measured, and a dev venv is not a like-for-like runtime footprint

design.deadline: 25s killable process group, equal for both tools
design.warm: second run in the same sandbox tree of that round
design.interleaving: trailhead and agent_reach alternate inside every state
design.sandbox: comparative.build_sandbox: environment isolation only, not a filesystem sandbox
design.asr: TRAILHEAD_DISABLE_ASR=1 exported and asserted for every child
design.credentials: none supplied; env keys validated against an allowlist
design.raw_payloads: kept in scratch, capped at 4194304 bytes/run

limitations: One host, one UTC window: latency and RSS here describe this host at this moment, not general performance.
3 public cases only; the wider public action surface is not exercised.
Warm means the same sandbox tree on a second immediate run: origin/CDN and tool-internal HTTP caches are not controlled.
Agent Reach stdout carries no truncation or pagination field, so its whole-artifact runs are recorded as truncation unverified and continuation unknown.
Child rusage includes any descendant process the measured tool itself waited for; the wrapper starts exactly one tool process and never a comparator.
Interpreter startup is inside the measured wall clock for both tools; RSS includes each tool's own interpreter.
V2EX node listing is a first page of topics: the case declares pagination 'page', so a first page cannot be recorded as an exhausted artifact.
No multi-day reliability (P2), consent lane, quota/ASR lane, GitHub issue/PR lane or account lifecycle is measured here.
